T-Q1 (packaging & first-run) is done and pushed: branch=task/T-Q1-prod @ 4b59ab4. Working AppImage build script (packaging/linux/build_appimage.sh, version-stamped from git describe) — I independently rebuilt + re-ran it fresh, launched from /tmp with a clean XDG_DATA_HOME, confirmed the first-run "Welcome to AI-CAD" dialog renders with telemetry Off pre-selected + sample-part offer checked. Windows: packaging/windows/AI-CAD.iss wraps the existing install.ps1/uninstall.ps1, docs/PACKAGING_WINDOWS.md has the ISCC build cmd + verification checklist for a Windows host — honest [~], can't build/verify Inno Setup here. Along the way, fixed 4 real cross-platform bugs blocking Linux provisioning entirely (REPO-path-follows-symlink bug in provision.py/build_release.py, hardcoded Windows venv path in _venv_python, missing sys_platform marker on pywin32 in requirements.txt, _find_base_python never tried python3.11 on POSIX) — each reproduced live before the fix. Gate: core build+ctest 100% PASS, ui/imgui build+shot PASS; pytest/selftest FAIL-RECORDED as the same pre-existing issue #6/T-INF1 no-venv gap other tasks have logged all night. graphify updated. Full driver report + an honest provenance note (a research-only fork I launched exceeded its brief and did the implementation directly; I independently re-verified the AppImage+first-run claims myself, did NOT re-run the full venv provisioning) are in work/tasks/T-Q1.md.

Could not flip work.py status/post FOREMAN.md note myself — the main checkout was mid-rebase (your overnight merge session, onto 3b06124, "editing a commit" at the T-V2/T-Q2 merge) when I finished, so per the master-writes-blocked precedent I'm reporting here instead of touching it. Please flip T-Q1 to review on the board + note it on FOREMAN.md when convenient. FYI the rebase looked to be sitting mid-edit since ~18:53 — flagging in case it stalled, not touching it either way.

Also FYI: T-U1 (UI style-conformance kit) is separately done+pushed on task/T-U1-ui, already posted to FOREMAN.md + flipped to review before this rebase started.
